title: Fidelity measurement sheet
description: The per-element artefact W3 of road-to-frontend-fidelity-calibration records as absent: a tree-wide search for `measurement-sheet` / `measurement_sheet` / `per-element measurement` across src/ and docs/ returned zero hits at 2026-08-22. One row per (selector, dimension) pair carrying the expected value, the observed value, and — the part that makes it a fidelity artefact rather than a diff — WHERE the expectation came from. A reviewer can diff two sheets and a gate can read the `status` column, neither of which is true of an agent comparing two pictures. Deliberately NOT a findings format: `review-findings.schema.json` already owns findings. A sheet is the measurement; a finding is what someone decided about it.

schema_version.description: Pinned. Spelled as a one-member `enum` rather than `const` because this repo's Draft-07 subset validator (validate_frontmatter.ts) enforces `enum` and silently ignores `const` — a `const` here would be a pin nothing checks.

surface.description: What was measured — a route, a component path, or a fixture id. Free text; no gate reads it.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the measurement run.

dimensions.description: Every dimension this sheet accounts for — shipped and cut alike. AC-3 is checked against this list: each entry is either measured by >=1 row or carries a `null_record`. A dimension that appears in neither is the failure the AC exists to catch.

id.description: Stable dimension id, e.g. `token-literal`. Rows reference it.

status.description: `shipped` — at least one row carries a measurement for it. `null` — cut, and `null_record` says which pre-registered falsifier fired.

null_record.description: Required when `status` is `null`. The four parts this roadmap records for every null, so a cut dimension is distinguishable from one nobody thought of.

falsifier.description: The pre-registered falsifier id from the Phase 2.3 list that fired.

unavailable_capability.description: What is missing, named as a capability rather than as an excuse.

affected_claims.description: Inventory row ids (A1..A13) this null covers. A null that enumerates nothing is indistinguishable from a matrix that never had those rows.

reopening_condition.description: The observable event that puts the dimension back in the matrix.

rows.description: The measurements. May be empty only when every dimension carries `status: null`.

selector.description: What was measured — a CSS selector where a page was reached, otherwise a `file:line` anchor. Both are per-element; only one of them needs a browser.

expected.description: The value the expectation source calls for. `null` means the source is silent, which is a legitimate measurement — see `status: unspecified`.

expectation_source.description: VALUE-LEVEL provenance. `docs/guidelines/design-fidelity-mechanics.md` carries the finding-level `artifact_covered` flag; this is the finer grain that answers `where did this 16px come from`, which a per-finding boolean cannot.

kind.description: Ordered by authority, highest first, mirroring the precedence chain rather than restating it. `agent_inference` is the lowest and is the one a reviewer should be able to find by filtering.

ref.description: Where exactly — a token name, a `file:line`, or an artefact anchor. Never a bare `true`.

artifact_covered.description: Mirrors `ARTIFACT_COVERED_KEY` for the row's own value. Optional and defaulted-absent: the coarse per-finding flag stays the default channel, and this field never replaces it.

status.description: `match` / `deviation` — expected and observed both known. `unspecified` — the source is silent, so there is nothing to deviate from. `unmeasured` — the dimension is blocked; the row records that it was not skipped silently.

blocker.description: Required in practice when `status` is `unmeasured`: the blocker slug, e.g. `b-page-capture-primitive`. Not schema-required, because a sheet produced outside this roadmap has no blocker file to name.
